_comment: Node self-update + component manifest. The INITIAL agent binary is served by the backend at /api/node-agent/<platform> (install time). These GitHub Release URLs are for (a) agent SELF-update and (b) the big components (sdrtrunk runtime ~250MB, rdio) the agent fetches on first run — hosted on Releases (a CDN) precisely so they bypass the Cloudflare-proxied backend's request-size limits. URLs + sha256 are PLACEHOLDERS: fill in the real tag path and sha256 hex at first release. The agent checks this on start, every 6h, and on cmd{action:'update'}: downloads to .pending, sha256-verifies, swaps the component dir / self-replaces via a detached helper, restarts.
